question: For which sport did Bhavina Patel win a silver medal at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games in August 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Table Tennis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Bhavina Patel won a silver medal in** Table tennis** at the 2020 Tokyo Paralympic Games in August 2021.
 
• Bhavina Patel **won the silver medal** after losing to **China's Zhou Ying** in the final of the women's singles class 4 event at the Tokyo Paralympics in Japan. 
 
• The 34-year-old, who was diagnosed with polio when she was 12, beat her Serbian opponent **11-5 11-6 11-7 **in a quarterfinal match that lasted 18 minutes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ​Anurag Thakur, the Union Minister for Youth Affairs and Sports launched the theme song** “Kar De Kamaal Tu”** for the Indian Paralympic contingent.
 
• Bhavinaben Patel hails from** Mehsana, Gujarat**.
